### ⌨️ Device Information

- **Device Name:** (e.g., SPC Gear GK650K Omnis, SPC Gear GK530, Endorfy Threepack, SPC Gear LIX Wireless)
- **Manufacturer / Brand:** (SPC Gear / Cooling.pl / Endorfy)
- **Device Type:** [ ] Keyboard [ ] Mouse [ ] Other
- **Layout / Variants:** (e.g., 104-key Full Size ANSI, 105-key ISO UK/DE, Kailh Brown switches)

### 🔌 Hardware Identifiers (USB VID & PID)

*You can find this in Windows Device Manager -> Keyboards / Human Interface Devices -> Right click your device -> Properties -> Details tab -> Hardware Ids.*

- **Vendor ID (VID):** `0x____` (e.g., `0x3299` or `0x258A`)
- **Product ID (PID):** `0x____` (e.g., `0x4E5B`)
- **Full Hardware ID String:**
  ```text
  HID\VID_XXXX&PID_XXXX&...
  ```

### 💻 Official Vendor Software

- **Software Name & Version:** (e.g., `GK650K Keyboard Software v1.0.0.3`)
- **Download Link (if publicly available):** 

### 🧪 Testing & Participation

- [ ] I own this physical device and can test experimental SignalRGB plugin builds.
- [ ] I am willing to capture USB HID packets using Wireshark / USBPcap or REA if needed.

### 📝 Additional Context

*Add any extra details, differences from the GK630K, or photos of your keyboard layout here.*
